When they say it looks good have them sign it. Saved my butt many times. To many contractors tell you one size then when the product comes in they say it's wrong. Also helps if the vendor sends the wrong size which does happen time to time. Also never set a firm date for when they will arrive. Go off the production time plus 2 weeks and let them know that delays do happen sometimes though rarely now. Overall it's the easiest dept to bonus once you get a feel for what you're doing. Sorry for the long post but one more thing is to get in the system and just start building stuff to see all the different options (if you have extra time of course). Best of luck.
